# Pirate Chain community

> An open-source community website about Pirate Chain (ARRR), an electronic cash network using shielded transactions.

## Pages
- [Pirate Chain](https://s-ftf.github.io/pirate.black/): Network fundamentals, open-source wallets, exchanges and atomic swaps, mining, publications, and community links.
- [vARRR](https://s-ftf.github.io/pirate.black/varrr.html): Verus network features, launch and supply, and public ARRR reserve verification.

## Sources
- [Website source](https://github.com/s-ftf/pirate.black): HTML, CSS, JavaScript, maintenance notes, and asset credits.
- [Pirate Chain](https://piratechain.com/): Project documentation and information.
- [Pirate Watch API](https://pirate.watch/api): Live observations used by this website. Values and freshness change; consult the API for current data.

Wallet software belongs to its linked project repositories. The reserve monitor reports a public API observation; the vARRR page also provides a viewing-key command for independent verification.
